claims.preamble: A method for training a neural network by stochastic gradient descent, the method comprising:

elements.label: a
elements.text: receiving, at each training step $t$ of a training procedure, a configuration comprising a warmup length $T_w$, a total length $T$, a base learning rate $\eta_0$, a base momentum coefficient $m_0$, a minimum momentum $m_{\min}$, a minimum learning-rate ratio $\rho$, and a coupling weight $\alpha \in [0, 1]$;

elements.label: b
elements.text: computing a learning rate $\eta_t$ from a two-phase cosine envelope, the envelope rising during $t < T_w$ and decaying during $t \ge T_w$ towards $\rho \eta_0$;

elements.label: c
elements.text: computing a momentum coefficient $m_t$ as a linear blend between $m_{\min}$ and $m_0$, the blend weight depending on the ratio $\eta_t / \eta_0$ and the coupling weight $\alpha$, such that at $\alpha = 0$ the momentum coefficient is constant during the $t \ge T_w$ phase;

elements.label: d
elements.text: applying the pair $(\eta_t, m_t)$ to the stochastic gradient descent update at step $t$.

claims.preamble: The method of Claim 1, wherein the linear blend is replaced by a power blend $(\eta_t / \eta_0)^{\alpha}$.

elements.label: a
elements.text: wherein the linear blend is replaced by a power blend $(\eta_t / \eta_0)^{\alpha}$.

claims.preamble: The method of Claim 1, wherein the coupling weight $\alpha$ is applied independently per parameter group of the neural network.

elements.label: a
elements.text: wherein the coupling weight $\alpha$ is applied independently per parameter group of the neural network.

claims.preamble: The method of Claim 1, wherein during the warmup phase the momentum coefficient $m_t$ rises linearly from $m_{\min}$ to $m_0$ over $T_w$ steps.

elements.label: a
elements.text: wherein during the warmup phase the momentum coefficient $m_t$ rises linearly from $m_{\min}$ to $m_0$ over $T_w$ steps.

warnings.explanation: Element [c] references 'the ratio $\eta_t / \eta_0$' as if previously introduced, but no 'a ratio' indefinite introduction appears earlier in c1. Definite article on first mention; recite 'a ratio of the learning rate to the base learning rate' first, then 'the ratio' on subsequent reference. Mirrors the claim drafter's note in the existing patent_review_report.md.

Claim 3 uses 'wherein' but the narrowing axis (per-parameter-group coupling) is structural rather than a numeric narrowing of the parent. Borderline case — flagged as info, not warn, because per-parameter-group application is a real differentiator supported by the disclosure's Variant B (Section 8).

Claims use 'coupling weight $\alpha$' uniformly; invention_disclosure.md mixes 'coupling weight' (prose) and 'coupling_alpha' (config key) — a TID/claim drift, not a within-claims drift. Surfaced for cross-document tracking; the consistency-checker agent picks this up separately.
